Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 9, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Dr. Charlie Bradshaw of North Coast Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
North County Transit District Budget Briefing
P2.
Proclamation declaring June 18, 2009, "Dump the Pump Day" to North County Transit District encouraging people to ride public transportation.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending April 30, 2009 (CC)
C4.
Agreement with the North County Humane Society & S.P.C.A. (CC)
C5.
Amendment to As-Needed Civil Design Consulting Services Agreement (CC)
C6.
Levy of Special Tax for Community Facility Districts FY 2009-2010 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , for District No. 92-1, North County Square;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , for District No. 90-2, Hacienda Drive and Buena Vista Creek; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , for District No. 2000-1, Hacienda Gateway Restructuring.
C7.
Encina Wastewater Authority Budget for FY 2009-2010 (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- .
C8.
Liens for Real Property Related Nuisance Abatement (CC)
C9.
Right of Entry Agreement for the Vista Conservancy (CDC)
C10.
City Ticket Policy (CC)
C11.
Neighborhood Stabilization Program (CC)
C12.
Collection of Delinquent 2008 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent weed abatement charges; and
2.
Set June 23, 2009, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2009 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2008 weed abatement charges. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Appointments to Various Commissions and Committees (CC)
1.
Confirm the Mayor's annual appointments to various commissions and committees;
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointment of Mary Contreras to fill the unscheduled Vista Unified School District Representative vacancy on the Public Arts commission for a term ending June 30, 2011; and
3.
Appoint two members to the Planning Commission for four-year terms.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Levy of Assessments for Fiscal Year 2009/2010 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , for the City of Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , for the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , for the South Melrose Drive Landscape Maintenance District.
PH2.
Moonlight Winter Season Ticket Prices (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , establishing the Moonlight Winter Season ticket prices.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
